profile_text.body:
Twilio Inc. is a for-profit public company headquartered in San Francisco, California, with ticker TWLO and CIK 0001447669. Its website describes a platform for conversational AI and APIs for SMS, RCS, voice, and email, plus identity verification. The company says the platform connects communication channels, customer context, and AI, and is built for engagement in what it calls the agentic era.

The site states that the platform lets humans and AI agents work together across channels, with AI agents drawing from internal knowledge and real-time data, and transferring conversations to humans with full context. Twilio describes flexible plans and pay-as-you-go pricing. The company is associated with 281 California law exposure entries.
